depiction.primary_object: two concentric three-quarter rings with an outward-pointing arrow
modifiers: upper-left pointing diagonal arrow breaking through the rings
depiction.composition: concentric circular rings cut away in the upper-left quadrant for a diagonal arrow pointing outward from the center

readings.meaning: miss target / off-target / out of scope

ambiguity: At small sizes it looks identical to a standard bullseye target or a mouse click ripple icon, because the outward direction of the arrow reverses the usual inward bullseye arrow and is easy to miss.

modifier_semantics.meaning: leaving the target, expanding outward, or clicking/interacting

reasoning: The icon shows concentric target rings with an arrow pointing outward to the upper-left, which reverses a standard bullseye arrow and also resembles a mouse-click ripple cursor. Because the outward arrow direction is subtle at small sizes, most users will mistake it for a regular target/goal icon or a click action, giving it only niche unambiguous fit for out-of-scope items, geofence exits, or outbound clicks.
